title: Respects the system’s preference for reducing motion effects
goal: Use prefers-reduced-motion to preserve static overrides for status prompts.
summary: archive prompt has a fade-in effect by default. When the reader requests to reduce the animation, the text and background color are displayed directly.
tasks: Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to turn off the animation of .signal.
Preserve fade-in animation when no reduction animation preference is available.

example.note: animation can be used as a supplementary reminder. When the animation is reduced, the same state can be displayed directly, and the information is still readable.

hint: retains the normal animation declaration, overriding to none within the media query.
